title: Ghost of Whiskers Past - Sissirat's Vengeance
description: Ghost of Whiskers Past - Sissirat's Vengeance — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Slay Sissirat's Vengeful Soul in Sissirat's Revenge, off of The Whisker's Library - Edict Section, slay 8 Sissirat's Vengeful Blademasters and 6 Sissirat's Vengeful Blaster, then return to the Townston Commander.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Slay Sissirat's Vengeful Soul in Sissirat's Revenge, off of The Whisker's Library - Edict Section, slay 8 Sissirat's Vengeful Blademasters and 6 Sissirat's Vengeful Blaster, then return to the Townston Commander.

Offer:

So, there IS a direct relation with what is happening in Rattle Tooth's Revenge and what is taking place in Sissirat's Revenge. I have a sneaking suspicion that Ratsputin is behind this. Oh...wait...we already knew that! Ha! We ARE good! Any way, the Townston Alchemical Association thinks it wise to send someone that isn't one of them into Sissirat's Revenge to defeat Sissirat's Vengeful Soul to see if there is more information that can be uncovered. Are you up for it? Good, I already signed your name to your will...I mean I signed your name to your field trip permission slip.

Head back to Sissirat's Revenge in The Whisker's Library - Edict Section, off of Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag and slay Sissirat's Vengeful Soul. While you are there could you be so kind as to also slay 8 of Sissirat's Vengeful Blademasters and 6 of Sissirat's Vengeful Blasters? Excellent! Good luck, Dungeon Runner.

Turn-in:

Is Sissirat's Vengeful Soul defeated? And his minions as well? I say! Job well done, Dungeon Runner! I would take a moment to relax and enjoy your accomplishment, because you are about to do it again!

Objectives:

  • Slay Sissirat's Vengeful Soul
  • Slay Sissirat's Vengeful Blademasters
  • Slay Sissirat's Vengeful Blasters

Level range: 78–100
